en_title: Forza Horizon 6 Reportedly Coming to PS5 in January on Disc
cn_title: 据称《极限竞速：地平线6》PS5版明年1月发售
subtitle: 实体版同步推出
opus_summary: 据billbil-kun报道，《极限竞速：地平线6》PS5版预计于2027年1月26日发售，实体版与数字版同步推出。微软此前坚持该版本会在2026年底前推出；面对新报道，开发商Playground尚未回应。

paragraphs.en: According to a report from reliable leaker billbil-kun on French site Dealabs , Forza Horizon 6 will finally land on PS5 early next year, despite Microsoft insisting it would make it out by the end of 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 法国网站Dealabs上，消息可靠的爆料人billbil-kun报道称，《极限竞速：地平线6》要到明年初才会登陆PS5，尽管微软此前坚持该版本会在2026年底前推出。

paragraphs.en: Playground's well-received racer launched on Xbox Series X and S and PC in May 2026. The PS5 version is now set to dodge a collision with GTA 6 , which seems to have its own track and street racing, and will reportedly release on January 26, 2027.
paragraphs.cn: Playground这款广受好评的竞速游戏已于2026年5月登陆XBOX Series和PC。据称，PS5版将于2027年1月26日发售，避开似乎也有赛道竞速和街头竞速内容的《GTA6》。

paragraphs.en: In August, Tom Warren from The Verge said that Forza Horizon 6 wouldn't hit PS5 this year. At the time, Playground released a statement insisting Forza Horizon 6 would. Playground has yet to issue a fresh comment following today's report.
paragraphs.cn: 今年8月，The Verge的Tom Warren表示，《极限竞速：地平线6》不会在年内登陆PS5。Playground当时发表声明，坚称该作会在年内推出PS5版。对于今天的报道，Playground尚未作出新的回应。

paragraphs.en: Since Xbox CEO Asha Sharma took over from the retired Phil Spencer earlier this year, Microsoft's gaming strategy has shifted to encompass limited Xbox console exclusives. Gears of War: E-Day, for example, will not release on PS5. Neither will inXile's Clockwork Revolution, which was made an Xbox console exclusive .
paragraphs.cn: 今年早些时候，Asha Sharma接替退休的菲尔·斯宾塞出任XBOX首席执行官。此后，微软调整了游戏策略，让部分游戏仅登陆XBOX主机。例如，《战争机器：事变日》不会登陆PS5；inXile的《发条革命》也被定为XBOX主机独占，同样不会登陆PS5。

paragraphs.en: Forza Horizon 6, however, has avoided a similar fate. Perhaps that's no surprise, given Forza Horizon 5 reportedly sold over 5 million copies on PS5, generating more than $300 million in revenue. Surely Forza Horizon 6 will generate signifcant revenue on PS5 also.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，《极限竞速：地平线6》没有成为XBOX主机独占游戏。考虑到据称《极限竞速：地平线5》在PS5上卖出了超过500万份，带来超过3亿美元(约合人民币20亿元)的收入，这或许并不令人意外。《极限竞速：地平线6》在PS5上想必也会带来可观收入。

paragraphs.en: IGN’s Forza Horizon 6 review returned a 10/10. We called it “the best-looking and best-sounding game Playground has produced to date, set in the most wonderfully realised map it’s ever crafted.”
paragraphs.cn: IGN给《极限竞速：地平线6》打出了10分（满分10分）。我们称它是「Playground迄今为止画面最出色、音效最动听的游戏，舞台也是该工作室至今打造得最精彩的一张地图」。

paragraphs.en: According to billbil-kun, a PS5 physical edition will land at the same time as the digital version. Earlier this year, Sony announced plans to phase out discs on PlayStation by 2028 , sparking massive pushback and petitions with hundreds of thousands of signatories .
paragraphs.cn: billbil-kun表示，PS5实体版将与数字版同步发售。今年早些时候，索尼宣布计划在2028年前逐步淘汰PlayStation实体光盘，引发强烈反对，相关请愿书获得了数十万人签名。

paragraphs.en: The report claims the price for Forza Horizon 6 on PS5 will align with the Xbox version, meaning it’ll cost around $69.99. As a first-party game, it's also available as part of Game Pass, although there are question marks over Microsoft's subscription strategy and day one releases . In July, the former director of Forza Horizon traced a line from the failure of the "well-meaning" Game Pass to the current layoffs sweeping across Xbox .
paragraphs.cn: 报道声称，《极限竞速：地平线6》PS5版的定价将与XBOX版一致，约为69.99美元(约合人民币470元)。作为第一方游戏，该作也已加入XBOX Game Pass，不过微软的订阅服务策略和游戏首日上线安排仍存疑问。今年7月，《极限竞速：地平线》前总监认为，初衷良善的XBOX Game Pass未能成功，与如今席卷XBOX的裁员潮之间存在关联。

paragraphs.en: Just this week, Playground issued a statement finally addressing its community after months of constructive feedback about Forza Horizon 6 was met with nothing but radio silence from the renowned British studio. A second team at Playground is also in the final stretch of development on the Fable reboot, which is due to be released on Xbox, PC, and PS5 on February 23, 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 就在本周，Playground终于发表声明，回应了《极限竞速：地平线6》玩家社区。此前数月，面对玩家提出的建设性意见，这家知名英国工作室始终没有回应。Playground的另一支团队也进入了《神鬼寓言》重启作开发的最后阶段，该作定于2027年2月23日登陆XBOX、PC和PS5。
